_dev_notes: RELICS -- passive items the player collects and carries between battles.
1. Add an entry to the 'relics' array below.
2. Required fields: id, name, description, rarity, cost, relic_type.
3. Optional: art_path (icon shown in shop and inventory).
4. effect: describes what the relic does at runtime (resolved by a future RelicEffectResolver).
shop   : Bought from the hub-world Relic Shop. Lasts duration runs then expires.
run    : Drops from dungeon combat. Lasts for the current dungeon run only.
Requires: min_level (int) and weight (int) for loot pool inclusion.
crafted: Crafted from materials at the hub (future feature). Permanent.
RARITY values: common, uncommon, rare, legendary
Controls drop weight in loot pools.
COST: gold price for shop relics (set 0 for non-shop relics).
EFFECT FIELDS (plan -- implement when RelicEffectResolver is built):
value:   numeric magnitude of the effect
trigger: when the effect fires (start_of_battle, first_round, on_kill, passive, etc.)
